list: The official 55 trophies, as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades are quoted exactly as published. Guides are written in the author's own words for this entry and cite their sources beside each trophy; where a specific step or count is not stated in the official description, the guide says so instead of inventing it.

sources.name: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to chase. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then side characters and collectibles, then activities and money — and this pops last. If your counter stalls at 53 of 55, check the missable flags and the 100% completion trophy first; those are the two that most often hold a platinum back.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks through normal play with no preparation and no way to miss it. Follow the on-screen prompts and the mission ends with this trophy.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock from story progress alone, so keep playing the main missions in order and this pops at the chapter's end. Nothing optional is needed for it.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it comes from main-story progress only, so play the missions in order and it unlocks at the chapter's close. The name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. It unlocks from story progress alone at the end of the chapter. If you are clearing side content as you go, do it between missions rather than after the chapter ends, so the story pace stays clean.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and it unlocks from main-story progress alone. Before the final mission, use this point to sweep up any missable-flagged story trophies from earlier chapters.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. It is a gold trophy and the story's endpoint, so it unlocks only after every chapter is done. Save before starting it: the finale is also the natural point to check which side-character and stranger trophies are still open before the credits roll.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is flagged missable in this guide only because it is a named, one-off story mission: the official description gives no replay guarantee, so do it when it appears and do not skip past it. The mission itself unlocks through normal story play.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are usually the set-pieces of a chapter, so come in with full health and armour and follow the crew's plan rather than improvising. Flagged missable for the same reason as the other named missions: it is a one-off story beat with no replay promised in the official description.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks through normal story play when the mission appears. Do it on your first pass through that part of the story, since the official description does not promise a replay.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is a named story mission, so it is flagged missable in this guide on the same basis as the others: a one-off beat with no replay stated in the official description. Play it when it unlocks and it pops at the mission's end.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The name points at Vice City International Airport, so expect an airport set-piece; bring a fast vehicle for the approach and follow the mission markers. Flagged missable as a named, one-off story mission with no replay promised in the official description.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The title suggests a large combat operation, so stock up on armour and heavy weapons before starting it. Flagged missable as a named, one-off story mission with no replay promised in the official description.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's stats screen. This is the long grind behind the platinum and the second gold trophy: it counts story, side missions, collectibles, activities and exploration together, so it only pops at the very end of cleanup. Work from the checklist in this guide, use the in-game stats page to find which category is still short, and finish that category last. The official description does not list the exact percentage breakdown, so the in-game tracker is the authority — unconfirmed at build time beyond that.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total. A stunt is a jump, a near-miss, a long airtime or a two-wheel trick — anything the game flashes as a stunt — so the count builds fastest by driving fast and recklessly on purpose between missions rather than by hunting a single spot. Find a long ramp or a jump you can repeat, land it cleanly, and loop it; the counter is cumulative across the whole game, so every stunt you do from the start already counts.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type in the game at least once. The list tracks 9 activity types as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; the official description does not name them, so the in-game activities menu is the authority — work down it and play one round of each. This is a sampler trophy: it pops the moment the last untried type is played, so do it early and let it tick off while you play.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 challenges in total, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Go to a shooting range, pick a challenge, and beat its gold score; each one is scored on accuracy and speed, so slow down for headshots rather than spraying. Work through the weapon list one at a time and use the range's own leaderboard to see which challenges are still short of gold.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every race location — 14 locations, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Each location is a separate race, so the trophy is a checklist of wins, not one hard race. Learn one track's line first, cut corners through the gates, and keep the drone low and fast; then move to the next location and repeat.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: winning the same race 20 times does not count, so enter a new race each time and keep a note of which ones you have already won. Street races, off-road and circuit events all count as races; pick a fast, grippy car, learn the first corners, and take the win before moving on.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: land the bigger or better catch than Cal within the time limit. Watch the line tension, reel in when the fish runs toward you, and ease off when it pulls hard so the line does not snap. Challenge Cal again if you lose — the trophy only needs one win.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in the world, start a game, and play it through to its end screen — finishing is what counts, not a high score. Pick the shortest or easiest cabinet you find first; this is one of the quickest trophies in the list.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Side-character strands work like mini-stories: take Andy's missions whenever they appear on the map and keep going until his strand ends. Flagged missable because it is a character's final mission — once it is done, that strand is closed, and the official description does not promise a replay.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Follow Kenton's mission strand to its end, taking each of his missions as it unlocks. The boat reference suggests water work, so be ready for a boat or waterfront segment. Flagged missable as a character's final mission with no replay promised in the official description.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Play through Billy's mission strand in order until it ends. The title points at riding solo, so expect a bike segment; bring a fast motorcycle. Flagged missable as a character's final mission with no replay promised in the official description.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as question-mark icons on the map; each strand is several missions long, and only a finished strand counts toward the 8. There are more than 8 strands in the state, so pick the shortest ones first and finish them one at a time rather than starting many at once. This is a silver trophy and one of the longer side-content grinds.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Play Randy's strand through to its end, taking his missions as they appear. Flagged missable as a character's final mission with no replay promised in the official description.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Follow Tyrone's mission strand to its close. Flagged missable as a character's final mission with no replay promised in the official description.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida — 18 spots, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Meditation spots are scenic viewpoints; stand at one and use the meditate prompt, then move to the next. Work through them region by region with the map open so none is left behind, and check the in-game counter after each one.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Talk to Bret to start the hunt, follow his clues to the animal's territory, and take it down cleanly — a scoped rifle and patience beat a loud approach, since a spooked animal runs. Only one specific animal counts, so follow Bret's directions rather than hunting at random.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, and a set is only complete when every card in it is found, so this is a hunt, not a purchase — the official description does not say cards can be bought, so do not assume a shop shortcut. Collect region by region, and finish three sets before worrying about the rest; the silver pops at the third completed set.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. This is a long location grind: every new spot you tag counts, so make it a habit to WAiNK It whenever you arrive somewhere new instead of saving it for cleanup. Work through the map's regions systematically and watch the counter — 100 distinct locations is the target, and repeats do not count.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges in total. Challenges are the game's small side objectives — driving, shooting, flying and more — and the counter is cumulative, so pick the easiest ones first and clear them as you travel. Open the challenges list, sort by the ones closest to done, and knock those out before starting harder ones.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Get the wanted level up by committing crimes in front of police, then break line of sight and hide — a parking garage, an alley, or a fast car out of the search area all work. Stay together with your partner until the stars clear; the trophy pops when the heat is gone, not when it starts.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route of three close shops first, then hit them fast: rob one, get out, and drive straight to the next while the wanted level is still active. If the stars clear, the chain breaks and you start over — so do not stop to fight police between shops.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts when you first get in or drive it, so the counter grows by itself as you travel — but the fastest way is to visit varied places: city streets, the airport, the docks, and rural roads each hold different vehicles. Hop into anything new you see, even for a second, and the discovery registers.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up: find a spot with at least five enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and take them down fast before it ends. A busy shootout or a gang hideout is ideal; do not waste the focus on one or two stragglers. If you fall short, retry the same fight — the trophy only needs one perfect run.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — that is, leave the airport in a way no timetable planned. In practice that means stealing a plane and taking off, or driving a vehicle off the runway area, rather than using the terminal normally. Expect police attention, so pick a fast aircraft and climb away from the airport at once.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not a checklist: the Rhino is the game's tank, so this trophy is about tanks. The exact trigger is not stated in the official description — unconfirmed at build time — but the natural reading is to get into a Rhino tank and use it, or survive its fire. Try driving a Rhino first; if that does not pop it, take one on in combat. Check the community guides cited here for the confirmed trigger once it is verified.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: crouch, move when guards look away, take the goods and leave before any alarm. If a guard spots you, the attempt fails — leave, let the heat die down, and try again. A night-time attempt with a fast getaway car parked outside makes the escape much easier.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape from each one. Each vault is a full robbery: get in, crack the vault, grab the cash, and get out alive — escaping is part of the trophy, so the getaway matters as much as the break-in. Plan an escape route before you start, and do the five vaults one at a time rather than rushing them back to back.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the city — spot one, block it or force it to stop, break into the back, take the cash, and lose the police. A sticky bomb on the rear doors is the classic opener, and a fast car parked nearby is the classic escape.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida — 52 areas, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. The map tracks which areas you have visited, so drive, fly or sail into each one and the counter climbs. Sweep the edges of the map last: the far corners and islands are the ones most often left undiscovered.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Gangs run their operations in different territories, so this is a tour of the map's underworld: find one operation per gang, hit it, and move on. Keep a note of which gangs you have already robbed so you do not repeat one.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy it with the view. It is a quiet, specific moment rather than a grind — find a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, sit with the view, and order the drink. Flagged missable in this guide because the description ties it to one specific place and moment; do it as soon as you reach Ocean Beach rather than leaving it for cleanup.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or drive one in, then floor it through the window. The trophy is about the exit, so make sure you actually leave the building in the vehicle.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl. Follow-through means completing your throw — play a frame or a full game of bowling at that specific alley. It is a small, one-visit trophy: find the alley, bowl, and it pops.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague — a partnership with mass appeal — and the exact trigger is not stated in it, so this is unconfirmed at build time. The natural reading is a moment with your partner that draws a crowd or goes public, such as a high-profile activity done together. Check the community guides cited here for the confirmed trigger once it is verified, and do not guess at a specific activity from the description alone.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices in the story — the description tracks them, and PSNProfiles notes the counter runs to 500. Choices appear in missions and conversations; pick one and the trophy registers the decisions you have made. Flagged missable because choices are one-off: once a scene has passed, that choice is gone, so do not rush through dialogue without thinking. The exact number of choices needed is not stated in the official description — unconfirmed at build time beyond the counter the community lists.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — the description implies failing something once, then succeeding at the same thing on the next attempt. The exact activity is not stated in the official description, so this is unconfirmed at build time: the likely reading is a mission, challenge or activity that you fail once and then pass. Flagged missable because a second attempt only exists if the first attempt can fail in the right place; check the community guides cited here for the confirmed trigger.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description is a reaction, not an instruction, so the exact event is not stated in the official description and is unconfirmed at build time. The title points at an unexplained encounter somewhere in Leonida, most likely a random event or a hidden oddity in the world. Flagged missable because a one-off strange event may not repeat; explore off the beaten path, and check the community guides cited here for the confirmed location.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — that is, hit a person with a melee weapon while driving past in a vehicle. Get a vehicle moving at speed, swing the melee weapon as you pass, and connect. A slow pedestrian on a quiet street is the easiest target; it may take a few passes to land the hit.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; they are not clean money until laundered, so take them to a contact who cleans them and bank the result. The counter is cumulative toward $250,000, so launder every marked bill you earn instead of spending it dirty.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. The counter is cumulative and counts every shop purchase — clothes, food, weapons, ammo, vehicles — so it climbs naturally if you buy gear as you play. If you are short at cleanup, buy expensive items you actually want, such as high-end weapons or a car, rather than wasting money on throwaway purchases.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in the game — 8 garages, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Garages are bought from the property market; save up, then buy them one by one. They also give you somewhere to store the 100 vehicles for Whip It Good, so buy the garages before the final vehicle hunt.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the app on your in-game phone, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it; repeat with 10 different vehicles. Any 10 count, so register the cars you already drive every day and the trophy pops at the tenth.
sources: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list
